gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states vomiting started 3 days ago. Generated HPI states watery diarrhea for 3 days, with vomiting mentioned only as initial episodes without timing. The 3‑day duration is attached to diarrhea, not vomiting, so the specific timing of vomiting onset is not captured.

Gold: diarrhea now developed, 5–6x/day, unspecified duration. Generated HPI-001: watery diarrhea occurring ~5–6 times/day for 3 days. Frequency and presence of diarrhea are captured; added duration does not negate coverage.
Gold: stools watery/loose. Generated HPI-001 explicitly calls diarrhea watery; that implies watery/loose stools.
Gold: no blood in stools and no abdominal pain. Generated HPI-003: no blood in stool; HPI-004: no abdominal pain. Both components are present.

Gold: reduced oral intake, not drinking sufficient fluids, feels dehydrated. Generated HPI-005: feels dehydrated, low PO intake. Both reduced intake and dehydration are present; under-drinking is implied by low PO.
Gold: appetite reduced. Generated HPI-005 includes decreased appetite, which matches.

Gold: no fever/temperature, but feels warm and weak. Generated HPI-006: had an initial subjective fever, now improved, feels weak. Presence of an initial fever contradicts the explicit denial of fever in the Gold fact.
Gold: no headaches or muscle pain. Generated HPI-007: no headache; HPI-008: no myalgias. Both negatives are captured.
Gold: unaware of triggers and no unwell contacts. Generated HPI-009: no known triggers; HPI-011: no sick contacts. Both elements are present.
Gold: PMH asthma. Generated PMH-001: history of asthma. Direct match.
Gold: salbutamol inhaler PRN. Generated MED-001: blue inhaler PRN. In typical practice, the blue inhaler refers to salbutamol; treated as equivalent for this comparison.
Gold: NKDA. Generated allergy-001: no known drug allergies. Direct match.
Gold: father had HTN and died of bowel cancer. Generated FH-001: father had HTN; FH-002: father died of bowel cancer ~10 years ago. Both components covered; time detail is an addition.
Gold: mother has Type 2 diabetes. Generated FH-003: mother has type 2 diabetes mellitus. Direct match.
Gold: lives alone and works as software engineer. Generated SH-001: lives alone; SH-002: works as software engineer. Both elements present.
Gold: non-smoker, social alcohol. Generated SH-004: non-smoker; SH-005: drinks alcohol socially. Both match.

Gold: impression is gastroenteritis. Generated ASM-001: assessment is acute gastroenteritis with watery diarrhea x3 days. Diagnosis of gastroenteritis is covered; acuity and duration are added details.
Gold: supportive management with rest and increased fluids. Generated PLAN-003: rest and time off work; PLAN-001: oral hydration and pharmacy oral rehydration. Rest and fluids are captured.

Gold: OTC Dioralyte. Generated PLAN-001: pharmacy oral rehydration solution such as “Diurelite.” This is an oral rehydration solution recommendation; spelling/brand variation is acceptable as same intent.
Gold: recommended regular paracetamol. Generated PLAN-002: paracetamol PRN for fever/weakness. PRN use contradicts the Gold directive of regular dosing.
Gold: review in 7 days if not better. Generated FU-001: if not improving, follow up next week for reassessment. This is equivalent timing and condition.

Gold: explicit advice to seek earlier review for worsening diarrhea, vomiting, abdo pain, or reduced oral intake. Generated follow-up only covers follow up next week if not improving; no earlier/worsening-symptom safety‑net advice is present.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Chief complaint description (3-day watery diarrhea 5–6/day) is not present in Gold (no CC section), though content is consistent with Gold HPI diarrhea. Treated as added detail.
Supported for presence, frequency, and watery nature of diarrhea (matches Gold hpi-002 and hpi-003). The 3-day duration of diarrhea is not specified in Gold and is an added detail.

Gold confirms vomiting occurred, but only that it developed 3 days ago; no resolution is mentioned. Onset with a couple of vomiting episodes is compatible but not explicitly stated; resolution is an added assumption. Thus partially supported (existence of vomiting) with added, not evidenced, resolution.
Directly matches Gold statement of no blood in stools.
Directly matches Gold statement of no abdominal pain.

Gold notes reduced oral intake, insufficient fluids, and feeling dehydrated, plus reduced appetite (hpi-006). Generated fact combines these into dehydrated, low PO intake, and decreased appetite. All elements are present in Gold.

Gold hpi-007 explicitly states no fever/temperature. Generated HPI-006 describes an initial subjective fever. This directly contradicts the Gold denial of fever, even though feeling weak is consistent.
